instruction: Add a folder named 'Work Links' to your bookmarks bar.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a folder named 'Work Links' in Chrome bookmarks bar. Uses custom is_expected_bookmarks metric with bookmark_bar_folders_names rule type that uses subset checking to verify folder creation. Similar difficulty to original task - single folder creation with different name.

llm_judge_reasons: The custom metric function correctly implements subset checking logic at tmp_funcs/.../chrome.py:66 using 'set(rule['names']).issubset(set(bookmark_bar_folders_names))' which properly supports 'add' instruction semantics.

The metric will correctly verify that 'Work Links' folder exists in the bookmarks bar, regardless of other pre-existing folders, which is exactly what the instruction 'add a new bookmarks folder' requires.
The getter function 'get_bookmarks' can successfully extract bookmark folder names from Chrome's Bookmarks file, providing the correct data for verification.
The postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure bookmark changes are persisted to disk before verification.
Complete instruction coverage: The evaluator verifies the single requirement - that a folder named 'Work Links' is present in the bookmarks bar.
